notes: Read all 127 numbered source lines before editing. This is a pure command-palette prefix-parsing module: no JSX, no DOM element, no Recharts/Leaflet/react-leaflet, no old web UI component, no API path, no unit-suffixed field, and no i18n runtime. Only String.charAt/slice/startsWith, Array.map/includes, Object.fromEntries, and the `in` operator are used — all identical under Hermes (React Native) and Node (Jest) — so every type, constant, label, placeholder, and function is ported byte-for-byte with identical behavior.
